desc: Ignition. A decision has been made and someone is leaving.
prompt: a car engine starting from cold, starter motor crank then idle, close, exterior
negative: music, speech, driving away, radio, crowd, reverb
note: Crank then idle is two events; this is the one place a single-source prompt has to name both or it stops halfway.

evidence.method: audio_sweep: rendered + measured (ffmpeg ebur128/silencedetect, librosa flatness)
evidence.note: renders and is not broken [seconds=3.99, lufs=-9.2, true_peak=2.2, silent_fraction=0.23, channels=2]
